summary: Design fair, skills-linked pay structures and talent systems. Learn practical frameworks, analytics, and templates you can apply immediately.
lede: Skills-based talent and reward systems link workforce capabilities to job structures and pay decisions. For HR, reward, talent and workforce-planning professionals, the course covers designing skills taxonomies, mapping skills to roles, and building progression and pay structures. You will also practice pay-equity analysis, reward governance and workforce segmentation, producing practical templates and an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape skills strategy, job architecture, and reward decisions and need a practical model they can apply immediately.
audience: People Analytics Analysts using skills data
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of HR, compensation, talent management, or workforce planning processes. Familiarity with Excel or similar spreadsheet software is helpful, and you should bring at least one sample job description, role profile, competency framework, or salary structure if available. No coding is required, and advanced concepts will be taught at an operational level rather than technical engineering depth.
